title.narrative: Strengthening Open Science Policy and Practice in Southern Africa

description.narrative: Support the advancement of Open Science in Southern Africa through a coordinated regional initiative. The 2021 UNESCO Recommendation on Open Science provides a global normative framework that guides Member States in building fair, inclusive, and sustainable science systems. It emphasizes equity, transparency, and participation, ensuring that no country is left behind in accessing and contributing to scientific knowledge. In the context of SADC, Open Science is particularly important because the region faces interconnected challenges such as climate change, water scarcity, biodiversity loss, health risks, and food insecurity, many of which are transboundary in nature. Addressing these issues requires shared scientific evidence, regional collaboration, and coordinated responses supported by reliable and accessible data.
